name: Declaration of Independence: Jefferson's Handwritten Copy
venue: New York Public Library, Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
why: Rare public display of Thomas Jefferson's handwritten copy of the Declaration of Independence, on view July 1-7 to mark Independence Day and the America250 celebrations.
